# MANIFEST: archive film on screen in the final cut (generated by build/paperwork.py; do not edit by hand)

Video: `videos/uss_samuel_b_roberts/full/uss_samuel_b_roberts_full_v1.mp4`. One row per film segment the shot lists put on screen. In/out = seconds in the source reel. Every film shot carries an on-screen tag saying what it is; shots that are not the Samuel B. Roberts or not this event are tagged ILLUSTRATIVE or named. **No 2022 wreck imagery (Caladan Oceanic, copyrighted) is shown.** No film of the Samuel B. Roberts herself exists in the sources: battle film shows other Leyte Gulf ships. NARA 'Undetermined' = US Navy film, federal work; NOAA Ocean Exploration video = US Government work, public domain (ILLUSTRATIVE deep sea, not the wreck site).
